title: population result
description: NOTE: no population-calculation.csv template was supplied in the case desk files, unlike deadline-ledger and evidence-index which do have templates. This schema is our own design, built to satisfy brief.md's requirement to 'maintain confirmed/lower/upper populations' and the FAQ's requirement to 'emit row-level inclusion or exclusion reasons' - it is not a confirmed staff format. One entry per in-scope jurisdiction (EU, Nigeria, California only - 'Other US' is excluded per dataset-row.schema.json).

confirmed_unique.description: Deduplicated count from confirmed_exfiltrated='yes' rows only, overlap_group collapsed once per jurisdiction.

lower_bound_unique.description: Same as confirmed_unique in this model - the minimum defensible count, excluding all 'uncertain' rows.

upper_bound_unique.description: confirmed_unique plus deduplicated 'uncertain' rows for this jurisdiction - the plausible upper range referenced in evidence-pack.md's board instruction.

included_rows.description: row_id values counted toward confirmed or upper bound.

excluded_rows.description: e.g. {row_id: 'DI-009', reason: 'confirmed_exfiltrated=no, network evidence excludes archive'}.
